text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT AND BARLEY TENDER - Japan's Food Agency said Thursday it cancelled its weekly wheat and barley buying tender because of the "Golden Week" holidays. The agency, which normally holds a tender every Thursday, said it would resume buying next Thursday.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka's Co-operative Wholesale Establishment seeks 100,000 tonnes of hard wheat in 50,000-tonne lots, government officials said. Tenders close on May 16 with the first shipment for May 22-June 5 if from the U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second shipment was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, the Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
WHEAT TENDERS - South Korea tendered to buy a total of 23,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday. Shipment was set for June 5-July 5 to Inchon.
- South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd has invited tenders to buy 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday, traders said. Shipment was set for June 20-July 20 to Inchon.

WHEAT TENDERS - - Pakistan will issue a tender on Saturday for 315,000 tonnes of soft white wheat from the United States or Australia for shipment between May 20 and June 10, an official at the Agriculture Ministry said.
CORN TENDER - The CCC was to seek on May 1 up to 50,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for donation to North Korea. The corn is for May 10-June 10 shipment.
SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC will tender on May 7 for 3,000 tonnes of U.S. crude sunflower seed oil for export to Mozambique, June 1-20 shipment.
- Jordan seeks to buy 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice for delivery in June, traders said. The closing date for offers is May 21.

COMMODITY TENDERS - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation seeks to buy 50,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet on Friday for June-September arrival. It also invites tenders to buy 30,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet or rice bran pellet on the same day for July 10 and September 10 arrival. If NLCF passes in whole or part due to high prices, it will re-invite the tenders on May 6.
- The CCC bought pinto beans, sunflower oils, bulgur and wheat-soy blend for donation to Moldova for June shipment.
MARKET TALK - India must introduce quality and safety standards in its emerging processed foods sector to bolster agricultural exports, industry and government officials said.

... Australia's New South Wales Grains Board boosted its share of China's imported barley market to about 40 percent in 1996/97 from about 10 percent in previous years, NSWGB managing director Graham Lawrence said.

... Iran is emerging as the world's biggest wheat importer in a development that puzzles trade analysts. The International Grain Council predicts that Iran will import 6.6 million tonnes of wheat in the 12 months to June 30, 1997. The huge volume puts it ahead of Egypt and Japan.
... U.S. soybean sales to China in the week ended April 24 totaled 52,500 tonnes, U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday in its weekly export sales report.
